name: ENF Novels: Dress Code
source:
ENF novels: dress code is an erotic choice based visual novel with multiple endings. The player will not directly impersonate a character, but will have control over the evolution of the story. The character Brigitte Wagner has 10 days to force 3 of her subordinates to resign, to do so she will resort to the most despicable means.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732760/]Steam[/url]]
